writtenBefore: any line of the implementation, and before the first run
theDefect: cfoAuditExport answers for a case id THAT DOES NOT EXIST with provenRevenueReturnedMinor 0, auditableRevenueMinor 0, currency null, excluded false and an empty chain. So a case with no proof, a case whose proofs were all reversed, and a case that was never opened are indistinguishable on the surface behind GET /audit/cases/:caseId/cfo-export — the most financially consequential read in the product.

measuredFactsThatDecideTheDESIGN.fact: FAILING CLOSED ON A MISSING ROOT WOULD BREAK A LIVE SCREEN, so it is rejected.
measuredFactsThatDecideTheDESIGN.evidence: src/components/EventDetail.tsx:73 calls governed.loadCaseTrust(event.eventId, …) with a SEED EVENT ID, and RecoveryContext.loadCaseTrust calls trust.getCfoExport inside a Promise.all. A rejection there fails the whole batch and the screen renders 'Failed to load governed case data' for every seed event. This is the same reason caseAuditTrail is deliberately root-tolerant — the two share that call site.
measuredFactsThatDecideTheDESIGN.consequence: the route keeps answering; what changes is that it stops stating a monetary zero it did not compute.

measuredFactsThatDecideTheDESIGN.fact: auditableRevenueMinor === 0 IS LOAD-BEARING AND CORRECT where proofs exist but are excluded or provenance-gapped. A blanket nullification would destroy an existing governed meaning.
measuredFactsThatDecideTheDESIGN.evidence: trustGate.test.ts:250-251 asserts provenRevenueReturnedMinor 1_060_000 with auditableRevenueMinor 0 — 'gapped — excluded from the CFO-grade ledger'; auditService.test.ts:162-163 asserts the same pair after exclusion. That zero is a FINDING: this proven money is not CFO-grade.
measuredFactsThatDecideTheDESIGN.consequence: the figure is nullified ONLY where there was no population to sum, never where a sum over real proofs came out at zero. The accumulator starts at the first established figure — the same correction ledgerTotals needed.

measuredFactsThatDecideTheDESIGN.fact: the two existing non-test consumers both call it for cases that DO have proofs, so neither observes the changed branch.
measuredFactsThatDecideTheDESIGN.evidence: server/agents/syntheticPilot.ts:307 asserts 5_000/5_000 on a case it has just proved; src/data/governedTrustClient.ts:218 is the UI client whose only caller is loadCaseTrust.
measuredFactsThatDecideTheDESIGN.consequence: the DTO becomes nullable and the one reader that could see a null is the UI, which must render NOT COMPUTED rather than coalescing to 0.
